nodes.label: PRJ93 — state brief
nodes.rationale: Written from the six docs/ files, the decision log ordering, log/ filenames and a live read-only Overleaf listing; no source files and no .tex bodies were read, so provenance of every statement is bounded and a live listing is allowed to supersede stale records.

nodes.label: External Examiner Examination Record (AI-assisted persona, 63/100)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly flagged as an AI-assisted examiner persona, not real institutional feedback, and it logs eight of its own errors — so its 2 Fatal / 14 Major / 3 Minor register is treated as a working defect list rather than an authority.

nodes.label: Fatal 2 — no LLM exists in the served system
nodes.rationale: Explicit ceiling: 'no quantity of statistical polish reaches 70 while the object of the research question is absent'. Surfacing is six hard-coded constants in briefing._score; the only Anthropic import was never run.

nodes.label: MASE ruler defect (Fatal 1–3: denominator, scale basis, median optimisation)
nodes.rationale: Four rulers span 0.836/0.399/0.597/0.672; calendar-filled is deflated by structural zeros, trading-only misaligns weekday on a 5.22-day week. S1 collapsed them to one denominator with a required basis, and the claim that the July forecast beat its backtest is now forbidden to quote.

nodes.label: W36 — absent alternative-comparison (stated reason Distinction is 'Not met')
S8b — the live-LLM agent run (blocked)
nodes.rationale: ~644 calls at temperature 0, agent versus the six constants; blocked on another party's API key, and S8c plus the whole Objective 3 results section sit behind it. Named 'the gate between contribution and decoration'.

nodes.label: S9 — manager-label evaluation (60–100 adopt-or-dismiss labels)
nodes.rationale: Fallback is self-labelling with intra-rater kappa on a pre-set trigger date, recovering only 3 of Objective 4's 4 terms — the shortfall is declared in advance rather than discovered late.

nodes.label: Pre-registration by commit ordering
nodes.rationale: Called 'the strongest thing in the project': freezing prompts and seeds by commit before a run makes the analysis order auditable, which is why any iterate-until-improved loop is refused.

nodes.label: ECE / reliability diagram / temperature scaling gap
nodes.rationale: Promised in the lit review via Guo et al. and existing nowhere in the codebase — 'the most expensive unforced error in the project', and cheap and unblocked to close.

nodes.label: FLAG-BAND-UNDERCOVERAGE-BH
nodes.rationale: 0.871 against 0.90 nominal on ~1,750 pairs, 3.6 SEs low at every horizon step and identically on the served exo model — a property of the band, not the point forecaster; falling below the Angelopoulos-Bates lower guarantee is itself evidence exchangeability is violated.

nodes.label: FLAG-CONTINUATION-ALERT-SUPPRESSION
nodes.rationale: Change-point-triggered refit fires on 61–63% of sustained shifts and, when it fires, suppresses continuation alerts in ~16% of checked cases — a tool that detects a shift, refits to accommodate it, and stops telling the manager it is live.

nodes.label: FLAG-ELLEL-DIARY (occurrence signal empty on an 82%-zero series)
nodes.rationale: is_ellel_event was correctly neutralised to kill a self-leak, which left the model with zero information about whether the venue trades tomorrow; the booking diary exists in the real world but not the dataset and is named the highest-value input available.

nodes.label: CPTC theorem misstatement (Sun & Yu 2025)
nodes.rationale: The chapter claimed coverage 'guaranteed even as the venue's regime shifts'; CPTC proves exact coverage only under exchangeability, asymptotic time-averaged validity under a stationary state distribution, and faster post-shift convergence than ACI. 'An examiner can check it in ninety seconds.' Closed by replacing with Barber et al. (2023).

nodes.label: S5 group ICL negative result (Chronos-2 called with id='l1')
nodes.rationale: A group of size one disabled the cross-series in-context learning that is the model's defining architecture — switched off by one string literal. The fix produced a negative result, and a latent batching bug (the batch is the cross-learning group) would have made it a false positive without the catch.

nodes.label: Forbidden-to-quote list
nodes.rationale: Numbers whose ruler or provenance is known to be broken are named explicitly so a later drafting session cannot reintroduce them by copying an old report.

nodes.label: Liveness gate (£5,329 overcount; two-state CPTC with ε=0)
ref.bib silent-repoint hazard (angelopoulos_conformal_2023)
nodes.rationale: A Zotero refresh silently repointed the key from Conformal PID Control to the Gentle Introduction and the document still compiled clean — compilation success is therefore not evidence of citation correctness. Never re-export via Better BibTeX: the key format differs and breaks ~60 citations.

nodes.label: W21 — PRISM already occupies the claimed unoccupied intersection
nodes.rationale: PRISM (Fu et al. 2026) combines cost-ratio-driven adaptive thresholds with ECE/Brier and sits in the candidate's own notebook — 'the fastest route to a viva you cannot defend'. Closed by repositioning the claim as field-deployment novelty.
